# nah_disk_attachment (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud disk_attachment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_disk_attachment" "data" {
  project     = nah_project.app.slug
  disk_id     = nah_disk.data.id
  instance_id = nah_instance.app.id
  device      = "vdb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Immutable device name matching vd[b-z].
- `disk_id` (String) Opaque parent disk ID.
- `instance_id` (String) Opaque instance ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque stable resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_disk_attachment.data my-app/DISK_ID/ATTACHMENT_ID
```
